problems.issue: Relying solely on a Facebook social media page instead of an independent, dedicated business website for the dental clinic.
problems.impact: Limits professional credibility, search engine visibility (SEO), and control over patient booking and patient education content.

problems.issue: Lack of structured schema markup and direct online booking capabilities on the landing page.
problems.impact: Friction in the patient acquisition process and lower conversion rates for prospective patients searching for dental services in Manila.

opportunities: Develop a dedicated, mobile-responsive website featuring an integrated appointment booking system, patient testimonials, and service price lists.
Implement local SEO strategies optimized for Manila to capture high-intent patients searching for long-standing dental clinics.
Showcase the clinic's 73-year heritage (since 1953) more prominently through case studies, before-and-after galleries, and trust badges.
audit.summary: Dobles Dental Clinic has a strong, long-standing legacy in Manila since 1953, but relies exclusively on a Facebook profile. Transitioning to a dedicated professional website with integrated booking and local SEO will help convert their strong social media following into a more scalable, professional digital patient acquisition funnel.

outreach.subject: Dobles Dental Clinic's online presence
outreach.body:
Hi there,

It's wonderful to see a practice with such a rich legacy in Manila since 1953 still going strong. 

I noticed that Dobles Dental relies solely on a Facebook page rather than a dedicated website. Without one, prospective patients miss out on easy online booking, and the clinic misses valuable local search visibility.

We put together a quick live demo showing what a modern, dedicated site with integrated booking could look like for you.

Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul
